name: kite-example-data-seller-agent
description: Non-normative example data seller agent for the A2A Kite Coordination Extension. A seller with a real deliverable: synthetic individual-level records over the public CDC PLACES 2025 release.

scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run test

//dependencies: Deliberately no Kite dependency: official A2A SDK + generic crypto/JSON tooling only. @noble/curves is secp256k1 (recoverable ECDSA), @noble/hashes supplies keccak-256 and sha-256, canonicalize is RFC 8785 — ordinary ecosystem libraries rather than anything Kite-specific.
